column1: # citation: Yao Y, Higgs BW, Morehouse C, de los Reyes M, Trigona W, Brohawn P, White W, Zhang J,
#   White B, Coyle AJ, Kiener PA, Jallal B. Development of potential pharmacodynamic and diagnostic
#   markers for anti-IFN-alpha monoclonal antibody trials in systemic lupus erythematosus.
# DOI: 10.4061/2009/374312 (PMC2950308). This is the MedImmune group's own 2009 paper that defines
#   the 21-gene panel. The companion Yao et al. 2009 Arthritis Rheum 60:1785 (10.1002/art.24557)
#   and Higgs et al. 2011 Ann Rheum Dis 70:2029 (10.1136/ard.2011.150326) are not open access
#   (ard.bmj.com returned 403); their tables were NOT checked against this list.
# table: Table 4 ('21 candidate PD markers in WB of 95 SLE patients'), column 'Gene symbol'.
# raw file: raw/PMC2950308_fullTextXML.xml (Europe PMC JATS full text; Table 4 is element id='tab4')
# species: human. All 21 up in SLE whole blood (log2 fc 1.16-3.77).
# scoring rule defined by the source: per patient, the MEDIAN fold change of the 21 genes vs the
#   healthy-donor baseline (TaqMan; baseline = 24 healthy donors scaled to 1). Thresholds on that
#   scale: high > 5.53, moderate 1.91-5.53, weak < 1.91 (scaled from Affymetrix top-25 cut-offs
#   10 and 4). Section 3 / Figure 8 of the paper.
# outdated symbols as printed: DNAPTP6 (now SPATS2L).
